EmailTemplate.subject: Your MA in social and cultural pedagogy
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the MA in social and cultural pedagogy at Arizona State University's School of Social Transformation! I look forward to assisting you as you consider your options at ASU.
About the Program: The MA in social and cultural pedagogy is an innovative degree that immerses students in the theory and practice of social pedagogy, and prepares them for working with diverse populations in a variety of organizational and community settings. The School of Social Transformation at Arizona State University supports students, faculty and staff to develop tomorrow’s community leaders and shapers. We embody our commitment to social justice, access, impact and excellence in everything we do.
Admission: We accept applications for both fall and spring admission:
The priority application deadline for spring admission is September 15.
Applications will be accepted until November 15 or until capacity is filled.
The priority application deadline for fall admission is January 15.
Applications will be accepted until May 15 or until capacity is filled.
In addition to the Graduate Admissions online application, applicants will submit:
2-3 page application letter describing their background and explaining why they want to study in this program. Resume describing prior educational history and relevant work/volunteer experience
Additional Questions? Visit our very helpful FAQ page, which answers common questions we've received over the years from prospective students.
Please let me know if you have any questions and thank you so much for your interest!
All the best,
Audra Horney, M.S.Ed. Academic Success Specialist School of Social Transformation College of Liberal Arts and Sciences Arizona State University Wilson 125 | 480-965-7682 | fax: 480-965-9199
